name: digital-twin-earth-controller
description: Digital Twin Earth display and local iPad controller

scripts.check: node --check server/server.js && node --check server/admin-service.js && node --check server/cluster-service.js && node --check admin/admin.js && node --check shared/protocol.js && node --check shared/forecast-binary.js && node --check main.js && node --check controller/controller.js && node --check scripts/forecast-binary-test.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:forecast-binary && npm run test:admin && npm run test:cluster
scripts.pipeline:setup: python3.11 -m venv pipeline/.venv && pipeline/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pipeline/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'pipeline[graphcast,cpu,era5,dev]'
scripts.pipeline:setup:amd: python3.12 -m venv pipeline/.venv-amd && pipeline/.venv-amd/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pipeline/.venv-amd/bin/python -m pip install -e 'pipeline[graphcast,era5,dev]' && pipeline/.venv-amd/bin/python pipeline/scripts/setup_amd_jax.py
